sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our long-standing relationship and appreciate that you continued supplying us at the old price during the earlier supply crisis; we also understand that cash flow matters to your family business. Our order volume is fixed, covers our full demand for this part over the term, and our forecast is rising, but we cannot accept the proposed increase as presented; please revisit it using current material costs, as your costing has not kept pace with actual material prices. Would payment timing help address your cash needs?

We confirm a binding volume of 8150 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01); our agreement provides for 90 days (ctr:4600070110).

On this basis we propose: EUR 125.83 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €133.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As to the index change and should cost and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We deeply value our long-standing relationship and appreciate your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we are pleased to accept.
In light of this delayed implementation, your binding volume, and the electricity index data, we can offer a revised price of €133.70 per unit.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €133.70 per unit.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to recognise the points we raised; we also value the way you continued supplying us during the earlier crisis, and understand that reliable payment timing matters to your business. The binding volume stated below is our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you, and our forecast is rising. In view of our long relationship and your movement in the last reply, our proposal below moves towards you again, while seeking to stabilise the basis for both sides.

We confirm a binding volume of 8150 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 126.53 (po:4500014428-10, po:4500014358-10, po:4500014313-10).

On this basis we propose: EUR 128.38 per unit, valid from 2027-01-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €132.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We did not know that - a fair point.
While we respect our shared history, those past prices simply cannot absorb the current realities of our production costs.
Valuing your commitment to the full volume of 8150 units, we are prepared to lower our price to €132.20 per unit, keeping the 1 January 2027 start date and 14-day payment terms.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing our proposal and moving your position; we appreciate it, and we understand that current production costs are putting pressure on your calculation. We also remember that you continued supplying us at the earlier price during the past supply crisis, and value the long-standing relationship between our two family businesses. Our full demand for this part is fixed with you, and our forecast is rising; our proposal moves further toward you, with all terms set out below.

On this basis we propose: EUR 132.27 per unit, valid from 2027-01-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
